caption:
It turns out people only see what they're paid to notice. The foreman didn't even look at me, just the crate I was hauling. Now that the cartridge is in my pocket, I can finally switch off the hum in my head. The silence is a relief.

The tracking pulse in the bay is still hunting the missing signal.

#neotokyo #industrial #stealth #technoir #urbanlife #cyberpunk #2097
